title: Successor integration factors through the explicit last-line contraction
statement: Let P be a finite purity setting [def-pur-conventions], Y separated finite type over k with structure aY, and d>=0. Write I_j:C_jT_j→A_Y for the actual ordered exceptional transpose [def-pur-ordered-affine-trace-data]. Let h certify bounded-below etale origin of H_(d+1) [def-pur-affine-space-binary-trace-coordinates], and hq certify invertibility of the specified coefficient-first projection for the last affine line with coefficient T_(d+1) [def-pur-affine-line-purity-comparison]. For the explicit contraction L_(d+1)(h,hq) [def-pur-affine-space-last-line-contraction], I_(d+2)=L_(d+1)(h,hq);I_(d+1). No trace base-change or binary-product hypothesis is used.

source.place: Integration on affine space, ordered trace recursion and projection formula

proof.text: The shifted Tate coefficient T_(d+1) is a finite-Tor constructible object: start with the constant unit, tensor successively with the locally free rank-one Tate line and shift by two at each stage. Thus it has a bounded ordinary etale representative for use in the line/composite transpose theorem.

Apply [lem-pur-affine-line-composite-transpose] at p=p_(d+1), M=T_(d+1), K=A_Y, t=gamma_(p,A_Y). Unfold the ordered comparison successor. Its source is inverse tateSourceIso followed by sourceReassociation and lineSource(tateSourceIso), precisely successorSourceIso. Naturality of the evaluation moves the last source isomorphism to the left. The normalized inverse compositor and canonical change to the standard line compactification give exactly lastLineContraction. The projection inverse used in evaluation and the one certified by hq invert the identical specified projection, so they agree. The remaining image of gamma followed by the counit is I_(d+1). Functoriality and composition associativity give the equality.

theorem integration_successor_contraction
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY] [IsSeparated aY] (d : ℕ)
    (h : DerivedCategory.plusEtaleOrigin (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (Ring P))
      (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 2)) (externalTate P Y (d + 1)))
    (hq : ProjectionInvertible (Ring P)
      (affineTraceLineCompactification (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 1)))
      (coefficient P.coefficients.l P.extension (P.level - 1)
        (iteratedAffineLine Y (d + 1)) P.level (annihilates P)) (tate P Y (d + 1))) :
    integration P Y aY (d + 2) =
      lastLineContraction P Y aY d h hq ≫ integration P Y aY (d + 1)
